mapping.author: claude-mapper-fdn-m5
mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Mold Adder: "Whenever an opponent casts a blue or black spell, you may put a +1/+1 counter on
# this creature."
# Event: Ghostly Pilferer's opponent cast, filtered to blue or black (COLOR_HAS in an FOr); effect:
# Lorescale Coatl's counter on this creature, behind OptionalEffect.
trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CastSpellEvent(
        filter=FOr(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.COLOR_HAS, color='B'),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.COLOR_HAS, color='U'),
            ),
        ),
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.OPPONENT),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=OptionalEffect(
        inner=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
            'count': QConst(value=1),
            'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
            'target': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            ),
        }),
    ),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever an opponent casts a blue or black spell, you may put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

mapping.notes: Ghostly Pilferer's opponent cast filtered to blue or black (COLOR_HAS); OptionalEffect around Lorescale Coatl's counter on this creature. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: mold_adder_grows_on_opponents_blue_or_black_spells, mold_adder_may_decline.
